correction: Supersedes the 23-family compression as the current portfolio taxonomy; preserves the prior 100-repository bench as evidence.
inclusion_rule: Create a distinct family when the candidate owns a materially different durable state model, authority boundary, workflow lifecycle, or runtime/integration boundary. Cosmetic variants remain overlays.

families.name: CRM and revenue pipeline
families.inclusion_criterion: Accounts, contacts, opportunities and stage ownership form the durable product state.

families.name: Case and workflow product
families.inclusion_criterion: Cases have configurable states, parties, deadlines, evidence and human authority—not merely tasks.

families.name: External client portal
families.inclusion_criterion: Untrusted external identities can see scoped records, submit requests and track their own history.

families.name: Project and work management
families.inclusion_criterion: Projects, tasks, dependencies, milestones and workload are first-class durable state.

families.name: Collaborative workspace (Notion-like)
families.inclusion_criterion: Documents and structured databases/views coexist in one collaborative workspace.

families.name: Knowledge base and wiki
families.inclusion_criterion: Authored, versioned, searchable knowledge with audience and review state.

families.name: Customer support desk
families.inclusion_criterion: Tickets, channels, SLA clocks, ownership, replies and customer history form the product.

families.name: Shared inbox and email operations
families.inclusion_criterion: Conversations, assignment, collision control, queues and reply state are independent of general ticketing.

families.name: Scheduling and booking
families.inclusion_criterion: Availability, resources, booking rules, attendees and cancellation state are first-class.

families.name: Events, registration and ticketing
families.inclusion_criterion: Events, sessions, capacity, tickets, check-in and attendee communication form a lifecycle.

families.name: Forms, surveys and intake
families.inclusion_criterion: Schema, conditional questions, submissions, review and response analytics form the product.

families.name: Document management system
families.inclusion_criterion: Capture, indexing, versions, retention, permissions and filing state exceed raw file storage.

families.name: E-signature workflow
families.inclusion_criterion: Signer identity, routing, consent, evidence and audit—not only cryptographic signing—form the product.

families.name: Contract lifecycle management
families.inclusion_criterion: Counterparties, clauses, versions, approval, obligation and renewal state are first-class.

families.name: Proposal, quote and CPQ
families.inclusion_criterion: Products, pricing rules, quote versions, approvals and acceptance form a distinct revenue lifecycle.

families.name: Subscription and usage billing
families.inclusion_criterion: Plans, meters, invoices, credits, dunning and subscription lifecycle form the product.

families.name: Accounting and general ledger
families.inclusion_criterion: Journal authority, chart of accounts, reconciliation, close and reporting form a governed system.

families.name: Expense and receipt management
families.inclusion_criterion: Spend requests, receipts, policy, approval, reimbursement and audit form a lifecycle.

families.name: Inventory and warehouse management
families.inclusion_criterion: Stock identity, locations, movements, reservations, counts and replenishment form durable authority.

families.name: Commerce and order management
families.inclusion_criterion: Catalogue, cart, order, fulfilment, returns and customer state form the product.

families.name: Procurement and vendor management
families.inclusion_criterion: Requisitions, suppliers, bids, purchase orders, receipts and approvals form a lifecycle.

families.name: HRIS and people operations
families.inclusion_criterion: Worker records, organization, leave, payroll inputs, policy and lifecycle authority form the product.

families.name: Applicant tracking and recruiting
families.inclusion_criterion: Roles, candidates, applications, stages, interviews, feedback and offers form a distinct lifecycle.

families.name: Employee onboarding and offboarding
families.inclusion_criterion: Provisioning checklists, documents, access handoffs and completion evidence span systems.

families.name: Learning management and course delivery
families.inclusion_criterion: Courses, cohorts, enrollment, progress, assessment and credentials form the product.

families.name: Marketing automation
families.inclusion_criterion: Contacts, segments, campaigns, journeys, lead scoring and attribution form the product.

families.name: Social media planning and publishing
families.inclusion_criterion: Brands, channels, content calendar, approval, publishing and engagement state form the product.

families.name: Newsletter and audience publishing
families.inclusion_criterion: Subscribers, segments, editions, delivery and engagement form the product.

families.name: Community and membership
families.inclusion_criterion: Members, roles, spaces, discussions, moderation and paid access form the product.

families.name: Customer success and account health
families.inclusion_criterion: Accounts, onboarding, health signals, renewals, playbooks and outcomes form a post-sale lifecycle.

families.name: Customer feedback and product roadmap
families.inclusion_criterion: Feedback, voters, themes, prioritization, roadmap and release loop form the product.

families.name: Website, CMS and site builder
families.inclusion_criterion: Pages, navigation, content models, publishing, themes and domains form a managed product surface.

families.name: Data and internal admin platform
families.inclusion_criterion: Typed records, relations, views, permissions and internal CRUD workflows form a general substrate.

families.name: ITSM, service catalogue and CMDB
families.inclusion_criterion: Incidents, requests, changes, problems, services, configuration items and SLAs form an ITIL lifecycle.

families.name: Asset, maintenance and CMMS
families.inclusion_criterion: Assets, custody, work orders, inspections, maintenance plans and history form the product.

families.name: Observability, incident and on-call
families.inclusion_criterion: Signals, alerts, incidents, responders, runbooks, status and postmortems form an operational lifecycle.

families.name: Voice, contact centre and AI receptionist
families.inclusion_criterion: Numbers, queues, calls, routing, recordings, dispositions and handoff state form the product.

families.name: Digital asset and media production management
families.inclusion_criterion: Media identity, metadata, renditions, approvals, rights notes and distribution form the product.

families.name: Identity, tenancy and authorization
families.inclusion_criterion: Authentication, sessions, organizations, roles and policy are supplied through a host-owned authority boundary.

families.name: Relational data capability
families.inclusion_criterion: Owned transactional data binds through typed resources while preserving one migration owner.

families.name: Object and file storage capability
families.inclusion_criterion: Files, metadata, access, versions and retention bind without forcing a document product.

families.name: Search and retrieval engine
families.inclusion_criterion: Indexing, filtering, ranking and retrieval are supplied behind a typed search port.

families.name: Notification delivery
families.inclusion_criterion: Templates, preferences, routing, delivery and receipts are reusable beneath multiple products.

families.name: Payments and money movement
families.inclusion_criterion: Payment intents, methods, settlement events, refunds and disputes stay behind explicit financial authority.

families.name: Connector and OAuth catalogue
families.inclusion_criterion: Provider schemas, credentials, actions and triggers are reusable while tenant connection ownership remains host-owned.

families.name: Workflow, rules and orchestration engine
families.inclusion_criterion: State machines, timers, jobs and human tasks are reusable beneath product-specific surfaces.

families.name: Analytics and BI engine
families.inclusion_criterion: Semantic models, queries, dashboards and embedded visualisation bind beneath products.

families.name: Document and PDF generation
families.inclusion_criterion: Templates, merge data, rendering and immutable output receipts form a reusable capability.

families.name: OCR and document extraction
families.inclusion_criterion: Capture, OCR, layout parsing, structured extraction and provenance form a reusable pipeline.

families.name: Realtime chat and collaboration
families.inclusion_criterion: Channels, presence, messages, threads and delivery state can bind beneath several products.

families.name: Maps, geospatial and routing
families.inclusion_criterion: Places, geometries, routes, travel time and geospatial views form a shared capability for field products.

families.name: RPA and browser automation
families.inclusion_criterion: Observed UI workflows, credentials, retries and audit receipts provide a fallback where APIs are absent.

families.name: AI assistant and grounded retrieval
families.inclusion_criterion: Model routing, retrieval, citations, tool bounds and conversation state form a reusable host capability.

families.name: Accounting practice operations
families.inclusion_criterion: Clients, engagements, close checklists, evidence requests, reconciliation and partner review are linked.

families.name: Construction operations
families.inclusion_criterion: Jobs, schedules, RFIs, change orders, subcontractors, progress claims and site evidence form the core.

families.name: Healthcare practice management
families.inclusion_criterion: Patients, appointments, encounters, clinical records, billing and consent form a governed system.

families.name: Hospitality property management system
families.inclusion_criterion: Reservations, rooms, stays, housekeeping, rates, night audit and guest issues form the product.

families.name: MSP service operations
families.inclusion_criterion: Client tenancy, tickets, assets, monitoring, backups, agreements and privileged handoffs form one operating model.

families.name: Insurance agency, policy and claims operations
families.inclusion_criterion: Parties, policies, coverages, claims, evidence, renewals and regulated decisions form the core.

families.name: Legal practice and matter management
families.inclusion_criterion: Clients, conflicts, matters, time, documents, deadlines, trust boundaries and billing form the system.

families.name: Logistics, TMS and fleet operations
families.inclusion_criterion: Loads, shipments, carriers, stops, tracking events, POD, fleet and exceptions form the product.

families.name: Mortgage and loan origination
families.inclusion_criterion: Applicants, applications, products, conditions, documents, underwriting and closing form a governed lifecycle.

families.name: Property and tenancy management
families.inclusion_criterion: Properties, units, tenants, leases, rent, work orders, vendors and inspections form the product.

families.name: Real-estate brokerage and listings
families.inclusion_criterion: Properties, listings, leads, viewings, offers, agents and documents form a specialised sales system.

families.name: Staffing and recruiting agency operations
families.inclusion_criterion: Candidates, clients, jobs, submissions, placements, timesheets and commissions exceed a generic ATS.

families.name: Field service management
families.inclusion_criterion: Customers, assets, jobs, dispatch, technicians, parts, offline evidence and completion form the product.

families.name: Education administration and SIS
families.inclusion_criterion: Learners, guardians, courses, enrollment, attendance, grades and credentials form institutional authority.

families.name: Restaurant, reservation and POS operations
families.inclusion_criterion: Menus, tables, reservations, orders, kitchen state, payments and shifts form a vertical system.
